---
title: "Greenland and Antarctic ice-sheet maps"
---

A0 poster maps of the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets: surface ice velocity
over hillshaded topography, with drainage regions, surface contours, the median
sea-ice edge and place names. Explore the same data on the interactive maps of
[Greenland](greenland.qmd) and [Antarctica](antarctica.qmd), and see
[Data & methods](about.qmd) for the sources. The maps are made with Julia and
CairoMakie; the code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/fesmc/cryosphere-maps).
